description: Add people to an item's WATCH LIST — the same list the UI's email button edits. `users` takes emails, full names or numeric userIds (e.g. ["rohini.k@simplify3x.com"]). Existing watchers are kept; the item is re-read to confirm. Use it after creating an item, or for an existing one.

itemId.description: Item id or business key (EP-66, FT-266, US-1326).

users.description: Emails, full names or numeric userIds to add to the Watch List.

name: watch_list_add
title: Add members to the Watch List of an epic, feature or user story
